DRAFT FOR THE ENGAGEMENT PARTNER · findings only, no opinion or conclusion · not signed or sent

Exception. The Debt Service Coverage Ratio computed as Section 1.1 defines it is 0.87 to 1.00, below the 1.25 to 1.00 minimum in Section 7.3. Current maturities of $4,250,000.00 include the $3,275,000.00 due at maturity on April 1, 2027 under the shop and yard note, which the definition includes. EBITDA of $6,060,562.50 would have been needed. The report states the finding; whether it is an Event of Default, and any waiver, is for the bank.

The borrower's compliance certificate reports a Debt Service Coverage Ratio of 2.67 to 1.00 and marks Section 7.3 as met. Its debt service of $1,573,450.00 leaves out the $3,275,000.00 payment due April 1, 2027, as its footnote says. Every other amount on the certificate agrees with the procedures.

Question for the bank. Section 1.1 defines Current Assets by GAAP classification. The balance sheet classifies all $3,912,450.00 of retainage receivable as current under the operating cycle; the aging expects $1,344,660.00 after June 30, 2027. Working Capital is $2,469,312.65 as classified, above the $2,000,000.00 minimum, and would be $1,124,652.65 without that retainage, below it. The engagement letter says a definition that does not decide a question is reported with both amounts; the bank says which reading it intends.

For information. Total Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth is 2.48 to 1.00, 0.02 under the 2.50 to 1.00 maximum in Section 7.2: liabilities $134,081.63 higher at the same net worth would have reached it. No exception.
Written representations from HANGS General Contracting LP have not been obtained. The engagement partner requests them, dated as of the report date, before the report is issued.

This is a draft agreed-upon procedures report for the engagement partner. It states findings only and gives no opinion or conclusion. It is not signed or dated, and nothing has been sent to the bank or the borrower.
